LanguageData.WotF_ManaVial.description: A small corked glass vial filled with pale-blue mana condensed from the colony's mana network. Drinking it immediately restores mana to a forest-blooded caster, though bottling incurs some loss, leaving less mana in the vial than the ritual originally drew.
LanguageData.WotF_ManaVial.label: mana vial
